headline: GOLD HITS $4,697 AS SILVER ROCKETS 6% TO $77 — GDX Surges 8% and GDXJ 9% on Middle East De-escalation
snippet: Gold climbed 3.1% to $4,697/oz on May 6 while silver surged 6%+ to above $77/oz as US-Iran ceasefire reports pushed oil prices lower and eased inflation fears. The VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) jumped nearly 8% to $92.67 — a 52-week high — while the junior miners ETF (GDXJ) gained more than 9% to $123.50.

headline: SSR MINING +20% ON BLOWOUT Q1 — Earnings Triple to $1.15/Share as Realized Gold Jumps to $4,770/oz
snippet: SSR Mining posted a blowout first quarter with earnings nearly tripling year-over-year to $1.15 per share on 84% revenue growth. The key driver: average realized gold price vaulted to $4,770/oz from just $2,935/oz in Q1-2025, demonstrating the explosive leverage mid-tier miners carry at today's gold price.

headline: AMERICA'S ONLY INTEGRATED RARE EARTH PRODUCER — MP Materials Locks In Apple and Pentagon as Customers
snippet: MP Materials has begun producing neodymium-iron-boron magnets and secured supply agreements with both Apple and the Department of Defense, making it the only fully integrated US rare earth producer from mine to magnet. Shares are up more than 168% over the past 12 months.

headline: COPPER ABOVE $6/LB — China Restricts Sulfuric Acid Exports, Threatening Half of Chile's Refining Capacity
snippet: Copper futures rose to $6.12/lb on May 6, the highest since January, as Middle East de-escalation lifted sentiment and Beijing's restriction of sulfuric acid exports — a key input for roughly half of Chile's copper refining capacity — tightened the physical supply outlook.

headline: USA RARE EARTH +72% IN APRIL — $2.8B Serra Verde Deal Adds Critical Heavy Rare Earths to US Supply Chain
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) rocketed 71.6% in April after announcing a $2.8 billion agreement to acquire Serra Verde Group and its mine in Goiás, Brazil — adding heavy rare earth elements Dysprosium, Terbium, and Yttrium that are critical for permanent magnets used in EVs and defence systems.

headline: CHINA SILVER IMPORTS HIT ALL-TIME HIGH — 836 Tonnes in March as Solar and AI Demand Fuel Structural Deficit
snippet: China imported a record 836 tonnes of silver in March 2026, surpassing 790 tonnes earlier in the year, driven by solar panel manufacturing expansion and AI-related electronics demand. Analysts argue the physical demand is structural, not speculative, underpinning silver's 150%+ year-over-year gain.

headline: MINING STOCKS PRIMED TO OUTPERFORM GOLD — Record $2,800/oz Margins and Compressed Multiples Mirror Past Bull Markets
snippet: The trend that may most surprise retail investors in 2026 is gold equities finally catching the metal. Record all-in sustaining cost margins of approximately $2,800/oz, compressed price-to-NAV multiples, and persistent institutional underweighting of the sector mirror conditions seen at the start of previous multi-year miner bull markets.

headline: POWER METALLIC DRILLS SECOND-BEST HOLE EVER — 22m at 11.46% CuEqRec at Nisk Lion Zone Expands High-Grade Resource
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSX-V:PNPN) intersected 22.00 metres grading 11.46% copper-equivalent at the Lion Zone of its Nisk polymetallic project in Quebec — the second-best intersection in the company's history — with higher-grade sub-intervals of 6.5m at 18.59% CuEq. An inaugural mineral resource estimate is targeted for Q3-2026.

headline: K2 GOLD STAKES 21,887-HECTARE DISTRICT PROJECT IN YUKON — New Wolf Claim 80km South of 3Moz Coffee Gold Deposit
snippet: K2 Gold (TSX-V:KTO) staked 21,887 hectares in west-central Yukon, assembling the entire >10km gold-in-soil geochemical anomaly — previously split among Teck, Ryan Gold, and Beringia — into a single land position for the first time. The Wolf Project sits 80km south of the 3.0 Moz Coffee Gold deposit being advanced by Fuerte Metals.

headline: ENERGY FUELS Q1-2026: First New US In-Situ Recovery Uranium Mine in a Decade Ramps at Burke Hollow, Texas
snippet: Energy Fuels (NYSE:UUUU) reported Q1-2026 financial and operational results including progress at Burke Hollow in Texas — the first new in-situ recovery uranium operation to start up in the US in over a decade. The company produces both uranium and rare earth elements, positioning it across two critical mineral verticals.

headline: PUREPOINT URANIUM TARGETS ATHABASCA BASIN — CEO Details Disciplined Drill Strategy as Spot Uranium Holds $86/lb
snippet: Purepoint Uranium Group (TSX-V:PTU) CEO Chris Frostad outlined the company's data-driven approach to drill targeting in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin, emphasising detailed geological modelling over speculative staking. Spot U3O8 holds above $86/lb as utilities shift from price-shopping to security-of-supply contracting.

headline: NdPr OXIDE FALLS 21% IN APRIL — Rare Earth at $99/kg Still 88% Higher YTD After China's Q1 Export Shock
snippet: Neodymium-praseodymium oxide fell to $99.61/kg in April — its sharpest monthly decline since Q1 — as early panic buying unwound following China's export restriction shock. Despite the correction, NdPr remains 88% above January's opening level of ~$53/kg, and analysts project a $95–$115/kg consolidation range through Q2.
